_how_to_edit: Meaning profiles for the semantic classifier (services/semantic_classifier.py). For each label, 'description' is one or two plain sentences saying what work the brand or vertical does and for whom; 'phrases' are extra ways funders describe that work. Brand keyword inventories from services/brand_keywords.py are added automatically, so do not repeat them here. Write the kind of sentence a call for proposals would contain, not internal jargon. After editing, run scripts/semantic_eval.py to see whether it helped.

Social Business.description: Enterprise-led development: social ventures, agribusiness and food businesses, market systems and market linkages for producers, value chains and post-harvest, farmer producer organisations and cooperatives, and the debt, equity and blended capital that funds them.
phrases: equity and debt investment in enterprises

Livelihood.description: Agriculture and rural livelihoods: raising incomes of farmers, smallholders, fishers, livestock keepers, artisans and rural households through farming, food systems, skills, self-help groups, producer organisations and rural development.
phrases: skills and vocational training for rural youth

Health.description: Health: public and primary health care, health systems, maternal and child health, nutrition, communicable and non-communicable disease, sexual and reproductive health, mental health, water sanitation and hygiene, and the health workforce.
phrases: primary health care and health systems strengthening
non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and cancer

E4C(Evidence for Change).description: Evidence for Change: research, monitoring and evaluation, impact assessment, baseline and endline studies, data collection and analysis, learning and knowledge management, and capacity building that produces evidence for programmes and policy.

Climate/Sustainability(ESG).description: Climate and sustainability: climate adaptation and mitigation, resilience, renewable and clean energy, biodiversity and conservation, natural resource management, disaster risk reduction, pollution and waste, and ESG.

Worker Wellbeing.description: Worker wellbeing: the health, safety, rights and welfare of workers in factories, supply chains and the informal economy, including decent work, wages, occupational health, gender equality at the workplace, migrant and domestic workers, and social protection for workers.
phrases: gender equality and safety at the workplace

Innovative Finance.description: Innovative finance: impact investing, blended and catalytic capital, outcome- and results-based financing, social and development impact bonds, microfinance and financial inclusion, and finance for enterprises and MSMEs.
phrases: access to finance for MSMEs and startups
